title: Script save as dialog suggest scene name
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.8.dev6.official [8898c2b3d]
v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (853x683 @ 60.02 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The script editors save as dialog 'save resource as...', doesn't suggest the selected script name, instead it suggests the scene name from the last time the 'save scene as...' dialog was opened.

### Steps to reproduce

- create a new project
- at the top middle switch to the script editor
- choose: file > new script...
- click the bottom left button: create
- choose: file > save as...

### Issue
The file input box is empty.

### Expected
Suggest the selected script name: new_script.gd

Continue steps
- click the bottom right button: cancel
- in the scene panel, click: 2d scene
- from the top menu, choose: scene > save scene as...
- note: the file input box suggests the expected selected scenes parent node name: node_2d.tscn
- click the bottom right button: cancel
- in the script editor, choose: file > save as...

### Issue
The file input box suggests the scene name: node_2d.tscn
even though the extension drop down only has one extension: GD (*.gd)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e7029d56-b452-4442-b200-e7a8a61c04cd

### Expected
Suggest the selected script name: new_script.gd

### Notes
The script editors save as dialog 'save resource as...' suggests the scene name that appeared the last time the 'save scene as...' dialog was opened.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aeabfc4a-cf6d-46c1-a12d-9e0de539bc7c
